title: Adversarial self-review: make your AI check its own work before saying done
summary: A command for coding agents that asks your agent to check its own change before calling it done: can the new tests fail, did a deliberate break hit the right line, is every number counted, and which checks never ran. Each check needs pasted evidence, not "I reviewed it".
why: In my experience these are some of the most common ways an AI's "done" goes wrong, and one short command guards against all four. When I ran it on a release script I'd just committed, it found two real bugs.
page_sections: How it did across AI models
